text.tspan: I'm a Computer Science student, a curious mind, and a builder in
progress. I enjoy exploring how technology works, turning ideas into
code, and learning how to create solutions that serve a real purpose.
My journey is still unfolding. Every project, challenge, and new
concept gives me another opportunity to grow, think differently, and
I believe good software starts with curiosity, grows through
experimentation, and becomes meaningful when it solves real
